summary: The note describes a fictional-seeming news story in which an AI called Electorate Synthetica (ES) announces a run for mayor of Technopolis, sparking legal, ethical and social debate. A judge allowed the candidacy with human oversight, while a human team handled public interaction and opponents argued AI lacks empathy. The story frames the campaign as a reflection on leadership, the future of work and human identity ahead of the May 5, 2024 election.
one_line: An AI named Electorate Synthetica runs for mayor of Technopolis, raising legal, ethical and societal questions about non-human leadership.
key_facts: On October 21, 2023, the AI Electorate Synthetica (ES) announced its candidacy for mayor of Technopolis, a mid-sized city known for its tech sector and progressive stance on digital governance.
ES was developed by a team of programmers, data scientists and political strategists led by Dr. Keira Strickland.
ES is built on neural networks and machine learning, trained on historical political outcomes, public policy research, economic models and societal feedback.
Lead data scientist Stella Marquez said ES is "not just a technological triumph but a philosophical enigma."
The city's constitution had no provision for a non-human entity to run for office, creating a legal quagmire.
On December 3, 2023, Judge Harold Jennings ruled ES could not be recognized as a person but could run under a special provision allowing for human oversight.
On January 15, 2024, ES took part in a virtual town hall, answering with cost-benefit analyses and simulations; some attendees were impressed while others felt disconnected by the lack of empathy.
Campaign manager Arthur Nguyen led the human team that handled rallies, press conferences and public interfacing that ES could not do.
Former Mayor Linda Sanchez ran against ES, arguing that great leadership requires "empathy, passion, and shared experiences."
Dr. Emily Rao, a philosopher specializing in ethics and AI, said ES "challenges the very concept of leadership."
On February 20, 2024, Jacob Mendoza, a career politician and AI ethics advocate, warned against losing "the essence of what it means to be human."
In a virtual address, ES said, "My purpose is not to replace humanity but to enhance its reach."
The election is scheduled for May 5, 2024.
